title: New workers' compensation submission: Lakeshore Dental Group

problems: The email does not say whether there is a written safety program, return to work program or drug free workplace.
The stated payroll and headcount exclude the six or so hires planned for the January 2027 Lincoln Park office, which falls within the policy term.
